verdict.rationale: Retell provides a free, no-payment-method web 'Test' call feature and Conductor simulation tests that let users try agent behavior without making real phone calls or touching production, plus $10 trial credits for sandboxed experimentation. However there's no explicit 'sandbox environment' or staging/production data isolation concept, no mention of separate sandbox API keys or test-vs-prod data separation. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment concept, documented isolation of test data from production data, independent verification of test-call isolation.
